tagline: Premier community bank in Texas with strong net interest income generation and credit risk management
hero_kpi_rationale: Master KPI for the banking sector; fundamental indicator of core business profitability and interest rate risk management

kpis.name: Net Interest Income
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from interest on assets minus interest paid on liabilities
kpis.description: Net interest income representing the core of banking operations

kpis.name: Interest Rate Sensitivity
kpis.explanation: Impact of interest rate changes on net interest income over 12 months
kpis.description: For a 100 basis point increase in rates, 1.5% positive change in net interest income over 12 months

kpis.name: Net Interest Income
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from interest on assets minus interest paid on liabilities
kpis.description: Net interest income representing the core of banking operations

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to interest rate risk, which impacts its net interest income. Simulations show that a 100 basis point fluctuation would result in a 1.5% change in net interest income, and 200 basis points a 3.0% change.

risks.title: Liquidity Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to liquidity risk, which may impact its ability to meet withdrawal requests and manage short-term liabilities.

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to credit risk on its loan portfolio of $21.9 billion. Allowances for credit losses amount to $281.5 million on loans and $51.3 million on unfunded commitments.

risks.title: Market Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to market risk, which may impact the value of its assets and net interest income. Fluctuations in interest rates and equity prices can have a significant impact.

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to regulatory risk, particularly regarding data protection, privacy, and federal prohibitions on interest-bearing demand deposits, which may impact its operations.

risks.title: Operational Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to operational risk related to customer data management, protection of sensitive information, and compliance with privacy laws.
